title: Mojaroni hal qilish va fikr-mulohaza
goal_uz: Dars oxirida fikr-mulohazani SBI modeli bo‘yicha berasiz, faol tinglash iboralarini ishlatasiz, keskin vaziyatni tinchlantirasiz va yechimni mas’ul hamda muddat bilan kelishib olasiz.

scenes.title: Mojaro va fikr-mulohaza
board: Feedback and conflict resolution
Modellar · tinglash · tinchlantirish · kelishuv
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda diplomatik tilni mashq qildik. Bugun uni ishdagi eng qiyin lahzalarda qo‘llaymiz: fikr-mulohaza berish, jahli chiqqan odamni tinglash, keskin vaziyatni tinchlantirish va hamma rozi bo‘ladigan kelishuvga erishish. Dars oxirida siz fikr-mulohazani aniq modelga solib berasiz, faol tinglash iboralarini ishlatasiz, keskinlikni pasaytirasiz va yechimni muddat hamda mas’ul bilan kelishib olasiz. Mojaro yomon narsa emas: to‘g‘ri hal qilinsa, ishonchni kuchaytiradi. Muhimi, to‘g‘ri so‘zlarni to‘g‘ri tartibda tanlash.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we practised diplomatic language. Today we use it in the hardest moments at work: giving feedback, listening when someone is angry, calming a tense situation and reaching an agreement everyone can live with.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar diplomatik tilni mashq qildik. Bugun uni ishdagi eng qiyin lahzalarda qo‘llaymiz: fikr-mulohaza berish, jahldor odamni tinglash, vaziyatni tinchlantirish va hamma rozi bo‘ladigan kelishuvga erishish.

scenes.title: Fikr-mulohaza modellari
board: SBI: Situation · Behaviour · Impact
Start – Stop – Continue
feedforward: what to do next time
sandwich: use with care

examples.t: In yesterday’s client call, you interrupted twice, and the client seemed frustrated.
examples.uz: Kecha mijoz bilan qo‘ng‘iroqda siz ikki marta gapni bo‘ldingiz va mijoz norozi ko‘rindi.

examples.t: Next time, could you let the client finish before you respond?
examples.uz: Keyingi safar javob berishdan oldin mijoz gapini tugatishiga imkon bera olasizmi?

examples.t: Please keep sharing your clear weekly summaries.
examples.uz: Iltimos, aniq haftalik xulosalaringizni davom ettiring.

scenes.say_native: „SBI“ modeli fikr-mulohazani aniq qiladi. „Situation“ — vaziyat: „in yesterday’s client call“. „Behaviour“ — kuzatilgan xatti-harakat, baho berilmasdan: „you interrupted twice“. „Impact“ — ta’sir: „the client seemed frustrated“. Keyin „feedforward“ — keyingi safar uchun taklif: „Next time, could you let the client finish?“ Yana bir oddiy model — „Start, Stop, Continue“: nimani boshlash, to‘xtatish va davom ettirish. „Sandwich“ — maqtov, tanqid, maqtov — ishlashi mumkin, lekin ko‘p ishlatilsa, odamlar maqtovga ishonmay qo‘yadi. Xulosa: „yomon xulq-atvor“ emas, „aniq voqea“ haqida gapiring. O‘zbek tilida „siz ishga sovuq qaraysiz“ degan baho beruvchi gap bu modelda yo‘q.
scenes.say: The SBI model keeps feedback specific. Name the situation: in yesterday's client call. Describe the behaviour you observed, without judging: you interrupted twice. State the impact: the client seemed frustrated. Then add feedforward, a suggestion for next time. Another simple model is start, stop, continue. The sandwich of praise, criticism, praise can work, but if overused, people stop trusting the praise.
scenes.say_uz: SBI modeli fikr-mulohazani aniq qiladi: vaziyat, kuzatilgan xatti-harakat va ta’sir. Keyin keyingi safar uchun taklif beriladi. Yana oddiy model: start, stop, continue. Sandwich ishlashi mumkin, lekin ko‘p ishlatilsa, maqtovga ishonch yo‘qoladi.

scenes.title: Xato: baho va umumlashtirish
board: ✗ You are rude to clients
✓ In the call, you interrupted twice
✗ Good job, but… (maqtov tanqid uchun “pardа”)

examples.t: When the report arrived late, the team missed the deadline.
examples.uz: Hisobot kech kelganda jamoa muddatni o‘tkazib yubordi.

examples.t: I appreciated how you prepared the slides.
examples.uz: Slaydlarni qanday tayyorlaganingizni qadrladim.

scenes.say_native: Fikr-mulohazani ikki narsa buzadi. Birinchisi — yorliqlar: „You are rude“ odamni tasvirlaydi va uni o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi. Kuzatuv esa: „you interrupted twice“ xatti-harakatni tasvirlaydi va uni o‘zgartirish mumkin. Ikkinchisi — tanqid uchun parda bo‘lgan bo‘sh maqtov: „Good job, but…“. Maqtov aniq va rost bo‘lsin: „I appreciated how you prepared the slides.“ Uchinchisi — vaqt va joy: fikr-mulohazani voqeadan keyin tez, tanqidni yolg‘iz, maqtovni esa ommaviy bering. Ko‘pchilik o‘zbek rahbarlari tanqidni jamoa oldida aytadi, bu inglizcha ish madaniyatida obro‘ni tushiradi, shuning uchun alohida suhbat tanlang.
scenes.say: Two things damage feedback. Labels, like you are rude, describe a person and cannot be changed. Observations, like you interrupted twice, describe behaviour and can be changed. The second problem is the empty compliment used as a cover for criticism. Praise should be specific and true: I appreciated how you prepared the slides. Finally, give feedback soon after the event, in private for criticism and in public for praise.
scenes.say_uz: Yorliqlar odamni tasvirlaydi va ularni o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi, kuzatuvlar esa xatti-harakatni tasvirlaydi. Maqtov aniq va rost bo‘lsin, tanqidga parda bo‘lmasin. Fikr-mulohazani voqeadan keyin tez, tanqidni yolg‘iz, maqtovni ommaviy bering.

scenes.title: Mashq: SBI bilan fikr bering
board: Situation: Monday team meeting
Behaviour: arrived 15 minutes late
Impact: others waited; start delayed
scenes.say_native: SBI modeli bilan fikr-mulohaza bering. Vaziyat: dushanba kungi jamoa yig‘ilishi. Xatti-harakat: hamkasbingiz o‘n besh daqiqa kechikib keldi. Ta’sir: jamoa kutdi va boshlanish kechikdi. Oxirida keyingi safar uchun bitta taklif qo‘shing. Baho bermang, faqat fakt ayting. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give feedback using the SBI model. The situation is Monday's team meeting. The behaviour is that your colleague arrived fifteen minutes late. The impact is that the team waited and the start was delayed. Add one sentence of feedforward.
scenes.say_uz: SBI modeli bilan fikr-mulohaza bering. Dushanba kungi jamoa yig‘ilishi, hamkasbingiz o‘n besh daqiqa kechikdi, jamoa kutdi va boshlanish kechikdi. Oxirida keyingi safar uchun bitta taklif qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: SBI
board: At Monday’s meeting, you arrived fifteen minutes late.
The team waited and we started late.
Could you let me know in advance next time?

examples.t: At Monday’s meeting, you arrived fifteen minutes after the start.
examples.uz: Dushanba yig‘ilishida siz boshlanishdan o‘n besh daqiqa keyin keldingiz.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „At Monday’s team meeting, you arrived about fifteen minutes after the start. The team waited for you, so we began late and ran out of time for the last item. Next time, could you let me know in advance if you are going to be late?“ Javob faktlarni beradi, ta’sirni ko‘rsatadi va iltimos bilan tugaydi. „You are always late“ deyilmagani muhim: bu yorliq bo‘lardi. „Ran out of time“ — vaqt yetmay qoldi. Sizning javobingizda ham uch qism bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model answer. At Monday's team meeting, you arrived about fifteen minutes after the start. The team waited for you, so we began late and ran out of time for the last item. Next time, could you let me know in advance if you are going to be late? The answer states facts, shows the impact and ends with a request.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Dushanba kungi yig‘ilishda siz boshlanishdan taxminan o‘n besh daqiqa keyin keldingiz. Jamoa sizni kutdi, shuning uchun kech boshladik va oxirgi masalaga vaqt yetmadi. Keyingi safar kechikadigan bo‘lsangiz, oldindan xabar bera olasizmi? Javobda fakt, ta’sir va iltimos bor.

scenes.title: Faol tinglash iboralari
board: encourage: I see · Go on · Tell me more
paraphrase: So what you are saying is…
clarify: Could you give me an example?
empathise: That sounds frustrating

examples.t: So what you are saying is that the deadline was never clear.
examples.uz: Demak, siz aytayotgan narsa shuki, muddat hech qachon aniq bo‘lmagan.

examples.t: Could you give me an example of what happened?
examples.uz: Nima bo‘lgani haqida misol keltira olasizmi?

examples.t: That sounds really frustrating.
examples.uz: Bu juda xafa qiluvchi eshitilyapti.

scenes.say_native: Faol tinglash odamni eshitganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Rag‘batlantiring: „I see“, „Go on“, „Tell me more“. Tekshirish uchun qayta ayting: „So what you are saying is that the deadline was never clear“ — demak, siz muddat aniq bo‘lmagan, demoqchisiz. Noaniq joyda misol so‘rang: „Could you give me an example?“ Hissiyotni nomlang: „That sounds frustrating“. Gapni bo‘lmang va suhbatdosh gapirayotganda o‘zingizning himoyangizni tayyorlamang. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi „tushundim, davom eting“ ga yaqin, lekin inglizchada qayta aytish — „paraphrase“ — alohida odat bo‘lib, ishonch beradi. Ovoz ohangi ham muhim: xotirjam va past.
scenes.say: Active listening shows that you have heard the person. Encourage with I see, go on and tell me more. Paraphrase to check: so what you are saying is that the deadline was never clear. Ask for an example when something is vague. And name the feeling: that sounds frustrating. Do not interrupt, and do not prepare your defence while the other person is talking.
scenes.say_uz: Faol tinglash odamni eshitganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Rag‘batlantiring, tekshirish uchun qayta ayting, noaniq joyda misol so‘rang va hissiyotni nomlang. Gapni bo‘lmang va himoyangizni tayyorlamang.

scenes.title: Xato: tinglamay javob berish
board: ✗ But that is not true!
✓ So you felt the deadline was unclear. Tell me more.
✗ I understand (hech narsa aytmasdan)

examples.t: Let me check I have understood you correctly.
examples.uz: Sizni to‘g‘ri tushunganimni tekshirib ko‘ray.

examples.t: I hear that you are concerned about workload.
examples.uz: Ish yuklamasi sizni tashvishga solayotganini eshityapman.

scenes.say_native: Odatiy xato — suhbatdosh tugatmasidan o‘zingizni himoya qilish: „But that is not true!“ Avval tinglang, qayta ayting, keyin javob bering. Ikkinchi xato — hech qanday dalilsiz „I understand“ deyish: bu samimiy eshitilmasligi mumkin. Tushunganingizni asosiy fikrni takrorlab ko‘rsating: „I hear that you are concerned about workload.“ „Let me check I have understood you correctly“ — sizni to‘g‘ri tushunganimni tekshirib ko‘ray. Bu iboralar suhbatdoshga uni jiddiy qabul qilayotganingizni bildiradi. O‘zbek tilida „tushundim, lekin“ ko‘pincha rozilik emas, e’tiroz boshlanishi bo‘ladi, inglizchada ham „I understand, but“ shunday seziladi.
scenes.say: The usual error is to defend yourself before the other person finishes: but that is not true. Listen first, paraphrase, and only then respond. Another mistake is saying I understand without any evidence, which can sound insincere. Show understanding by repeating the key point: I hear that you are concerned about workload. Let me check I have understood correctly.
scenes.say_uz: Odatiy xato — suhbatdosh tugatmasdan o‘zingizni himoya qilish. Avval tinglang, qayta ayting, keyin javob bering. Hech qanday dalilsiz I understand deyish samimiy eshitilmasligi mumkin. Tushunganingizni asosiy fikrni takrorlab ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Mashq: qayta ayting
board: Colleague: Nobody told me the client had changed the brief. I wasted three days and now I am blamed.
1) paraphrase  2) name the feeling  3) ask for detail
scenes.say_native: Hamkasbingiz aytadi: „Nobody told me the client had changed the brief. I wasted three days, and now I am being blamed.“ Faol tinglashning uchta usuli bilan javob bering: eshitganingizni qayta ayting, hissiyotni nomlang va bitta tafsilot so‘rang. O‘zingizni oqlamang. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: A colleague says: nobody told me the client had changed the brief. I wasted three days, and now I am being blamed. Respond with three active-listening moves: paraphrase what you heard, name the feeling, and ask for one detail.
scenes.say_uz: Hamkasbingiz aytadi: hech kim menga mijoz topshiriqni o‘zgartirganini aytmadi, men uch kunni bekorga sarfladim va endi meni ayblashmoqda. Uchta usul bilan javob bering: qayta ayting, hissiyotni nomlang va bitta tafsilot so‘rang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: faol tinglash
board: So you were not told about the change, and the work was wasted.
That sounds really frustrating.
When did you first find out?

examples.t: So you were not told about the change, and three days of work were lost.
examples.uz: Demak, sizga o‘zgarish haqida aytilmagan va uch kunlik ish yo‘qqa chiqqan.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin javob: „So you were not told about the change, and three days of work were lost.“ — qayta aytish. „That sounds really frustrating, especially now that you are being blamed.“ — hissiyotni nomlash. „When did you first find out about the new brief?“ — tafsilot so‘rash. Har bir qism o‘z vazifasini bajaradi: birinchisi faktni tekshiradi, ikkinchisi his-tuyg‘uni tan oladi, uchinchisi muammoni hal qilishga yo‘naltiradi. Aybni muhokama qilmadingiz va „to‘g‘ri aytyapsiz“ deb rozilik ham bermadingiz: bu muvozanat professionallik.
scenes.say: Possible response. So you were not told about the change, and three days of work were lost. That sounds really frustrating, especially now that you are being blamed. When did you first find out about the new brief? Each part does a different job: the first checks the facts, the second acknowledges feeling, and the third moves towards solving the problem.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javob. Demak, sizga o‘zgarish haqida aytilmagan va uch kunlik ish yo‘qqa chiqqan. Bu, ayniqsa endi sizni ayblayotganlarida, juda xafa qiluvchi eshitilyapti. Yangi topshiriq haqida birinchi marta qachon bildingiz? Har bir qism o‘z vazifasini bajaradi.

scenes.title: Keskinlikni pasaytirish
board: lower your voice, slow down
acknowledge first: I can see why you are upset
take a pause: Let us take a moment
focus: What matters now is…

examples.t: I can see why you are upset, and I want to help put this right.
examples.uz: Nega xafa ekaningizni ko‘ryapman va buni to‘g‘rilashga yordam bermoqchiman.

examples.t: Let us take a moment, and then go through it step by step.
examples.uz: Keling, bir lahza to‘xtaylik, keyin hammasini bosqichma-bosqich ko‘rib chiqamiz.

examples.t: What matters now is getting the order to you by Friday.
examples.uz: Hozir muhimi — buyurtmani juma kuni sizga yetkazish.

scenes.say_native: Keskinlikni pasaytirish uchun avval sur’atni o‘zgartiring, keyin so‘zlarni. Ovozni pasaytiring va sekinroq gapiring. Avval hissiyotni tan oling: „I can see why you are upset.“ Pauza taklif qiling: „Let us take a moment.“ Keyin kelajakka e’tibor qarating: „What matters now is getting this fixed.“ „Calm down“ — tinchlaning — demang: ko‘pincha bu odamni battar jahlini chiqaradi, chunki hissiyotini kamsitgandek eshitiladi. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi „jahlingizni bosing“ ga ham taalluqli: iltimosdan ko‘ra ko‘rsatma kabi tuyuladi. Tan olish yechimdan oldin kelsa, odam tinglashga tayyor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: To de-escalate, change the pace before the words. Lower your voice and slow down. Acknowledge the emotion first: I can see why you are upset. Offer a pause: let us take a moment. Then focus on the future: what matters now is getting this fixed. Avoid telling people to calm down, because it often makes them angrier.
scenes.say_uz: Keskinlikni pasaytirish uchun avval sur’atni o‘zgartiring. Ovozni pasaytiring va sekinroq gapiring. Avval hissiyotni tan oling, pauza taklif qiling, keyin kelajakka e’tibor qarating. Calm down demang, chunki bu odamni battar jahlini chiqaradi.

scenes.title: Xato: calm down va you-ayblovlar
board: ✗ Calm down, you are overreacting
✓ I can see this is important to you
✗ You are shouting! / ✓ Let us lower our voices a little

examples.t: I apologise for the confusion, and I will find out what happened.
examples.uz: Chalkashlik uchun uzr so‘rayman va nima bo‘lganini aniqlayman.

examples.t: Let us find a way forward together.
examples.uz: Keling, oldinga yo‘lni birga topaylik.

scenes.say_native: Mojaroni alangalatadigan uchta ibora: „calm down“, „you are overreacting“, „you are shouting“. Ular odamga hujum qiladi. Ularni vaziyat haqidagi gap va umumiy maqsad bilan almashtiring: „I can see this is important to you“ yoki „Let us lower our voices a little so we can solve it“ — keling, ovozimizni biroz pasaytiraylik. Aybingiz bo‘lsa, qisqa uzr so‘rang: „I apologise for the confusion, and I will find out what happened.“ Faktlar haqida bahsni hissiyot pasaygandan keyin boshlang. „Overreact“ — haddan ortiq reaksiya bildirmoq, bu so‘z ayblov bo‘lgani uchun ishlatmang. Suhbatni „biz“ shakliga o‘tkazish — eng kuchli usullardan biri.
scenes.say: Three phrases inflame a conflict: calm down, you are overreacting and you are shouting. They attack the person. Replace them with statements about the situation and a shared aim: I can see this is important to you, or let us lower our voices a little so we can solve it. When the fault is yours, apologise briefly. Only argue about facts after the emotion has eased.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta ibora mojaroni alangalatadi: calm down, you are overreacting va you are shouting. Ularni vaziyat haqidagi gap va umumiy maqsad bilan almashtiring. Aybingiz bo‘lsa, qisqa uzr so‘rang. Faktlar haqida bahsni hissiyot pasaygandan keyin boshlang.

scenes.title: Mashq: tinchlantiring
board: Customer: This is the third time my order is wrong! This is unacceptable!
1) acknowledge  2) apologise briefly  3) focus on the fix
scenes.say_native: Mijoz jahl bilan aytadi: „This is the third time my order is wrong! This is unacceptable!“ Uch qadamda tinchlantiring: hissiyotni tan oling, qisqa uzr so‘rang va „calm down“ demasdan yechimga o‘ting. Ovoz ohangi past va sekin bo‘lishini ham tasavvur qiling. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: A customer says angrily: this is the third time my order is wrong, and it is unacceptable. De-escalate in three steps. Acknowledge the feeling, apologise briefly, and focus on the fix without telling the customer to calm down.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz jahl bilan aytadi: buyurtmam uchinchi marta noto‘g‘ri, bu qabul qilib bo‘lmaydi. Uch qadamda tinchlantiring: hissiyotni tan oling, qisqa uzr so‘rang va calm down demasdan yechimga o‘ting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinchlantirish
board: I can see why you are upset, and you are right.
I am very sorry.
What matters now is getting it right today.

examples.t: I am very sorry; this should not have happened three times.
examples.uz: Juda uzr, bu uch marta takrorlanmasligi kerak edi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „I can see why you are upset, and I am very sorry. This should not have happened three times. What matters now is getting your order right today, so may I check the details with you and arrange delivery this afternoon?“ Javob tan oladi, uzr so‘raydi va keyingi qadamga o‘tadi, himoyalanmaydi va ayblamaydi. „This should not have happened“ — bu bo‘lmasligi kerak edi, bu o‘tgan zamonga nisbatan „should not have + III shakl“ qolipi. Bu muloyim tarzda aybni tan olish usuli.
scenes.say: A model response. I can see why you are upset, and I am very sorry. This should not have happened three times. What matters now is getting your order right today, so may I check the details with you and arrange delivery this afternoon? The response acknowledges, apologises and focuses on the next step, without defending or blaming.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Nega xafa ekaningizni ko‘ryapman, juda uzr, bu uch marta takrorlanmasligi kerak edi. Hozir muhimi — buyurtmangizni bugun to‘g‘ri yetkazish. Tafsilotlarni tekshirib, bugun tushdan keyin yetkazishni tashkil qilsam bo‘ladimi? Javob tan oladi, uzr so‘raydi va keyingi qadamga o‘tadi.

scenes.title: Yechimni kelishish
board: What would work for you?
Shall we agree that…? · Let us meet halfway
Who does what by when?
To summarise, we have agreed…

examples.t: What would work for you? I can offer a refund or a replacement.
examples.uz: Sizga nima mos? Men pulni qaytarish yoki almashtirishni taklif qila olaman.

examples.t: Shall we agree that Sara sends the draft by Wednesday?
examples.uz: Sara qoralamani chorshanbagacha yuborishiga kelishib olamizmi?

examples.t: To summarise, we have agreed three actions, with owners and deadlines.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, biz mas’ul va muddatlari bilan uchta amalga kelishdik.

scenes.say_native: Kelishuvga erishish uchun avval ikkinchi tomonga nima mos kelishini so‘rang: „What would work for you?“ Bitta emas, bir nechta variant taklif qiling. Murosa taklif qiling: „Shall we meet halfway?“ — o‘rtasidan kelishaylikmi? Har bir harakatni aniqlashtiring: kim, nima, qachongacha. Keyin ovoz chiqarib xulosa qiling: „To summarise, we have agreed that…“ „Are we on the same page?“ — fikrimiz bir joydami? — deb majburiyatni tekshiring va keyin yozma tasdiqlang. Yozma tasdiq uchrashuvdan keyin ikki tomon uchun xotira vazifasini bajaradi. O‘zbek madaniyatida og‘zaki kelishuv ko‘p qadrlanadi, ish muhitida esa yozma tasdiq ishonchni kuchaytiradi.
scenes.say: To reach agreement, ask what would work for the other side. Offer options, not a single solution. Propose compromises: shall we meet halfway? Make every action concrete with who, what and by when. Then summarise aloud: to summarise, we have agreed that. Check commitment with are we on the same page? and confirm in writing afterwards.
scenes.say_uz: Kelishuvga erishish uchun ikkinchi tomonga nima mos kelishini so‘rang. Bir nechta variant taklif qiling. Murosa taklif qiling. Har bir harakatni kim, nima va qachongacha bilan aniqlashtiring. Ovoz chiqarib xulosa qiling va yozma tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Xato: noaniq kelishuv
board: ✗ We will sort it out soon
✓ Sara will send the draft by Wednesday noon
✗ I think we agree?

examples.t: Let us put the agreement in an email today.
examples.uz: Kelishuvni bugun elektron xatda rasmiylashtiraylik.

examples.t: Is that acceptable to everyone?
examples.uz: Bu hamma uchun maqbulmi?

scenes.say_native: Noaniq kelishuv parchalanib ketadi. „We will sort it out soon“ — hech kimni va hech qanday sanani ko‘rsatmaydi. Uni odam, harakat va muddat bilan almashtiring: „Sara will send the draft by Wednesday noon.“ Hamma haqiqatan rozi ekanini tekshiring: „Is that acceptable to everyone?“ Sukutni rozilik deb hisoblamang. Yana bir grammatik nozik nuqta: „agree with“ — odam yoki fikr bilan rozi bo‘lish: „I agree with you“, „agree to“ — taklifga rozilik berish: „I agree to the new deadline“. O‘zbek tilida ikkalasi ham „rozi bo‘ldim“ bo‘lgani uchun predlogni adashtirish oson.
scenes.say: Vague agreements fall apart. We will sort it out soon names nobody and no date. Replace it with a person, an action and a deadline: Sara will send the draft by Wednesday noon. Also check that everyone really agrees, with is that acceptable to everyone, rather than assuming silence means yes. And do not confuse agree with and agree to: you agree with a person, and agree to a proposal.
scenes.say_uz: Noaniq kelishuv parchalanib ketadi. We will sort it out soon hech kimni va sanani ko‘rsatmaydi. Uni odam, harakat va muddat bilan almashtiring. Hamma haqiqatan rozi ekanini tekshiring. Agree with odam yoki fikr bilan, agree to taklifga rozilikni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Mashq: kelishuvni yakunlang
board: Dispute: Tom says Lena sends reports late; Lena says data arrives late.
Agree a solution with owner + deadline
scenes.say_native: Ikki hamkasb bahslashmoqda. Tom Lena hisobotlarni kech yuboradi, deydi. Lena esa kerakli ma’lumot kech keladi, deydi. Mediator sifatida har bir harakat uchun mas’ul va muddatli yechim taklif qiling va kelishuvni ikki gapda xulosa qiling. „Who does what by when“ qolipidan foydalaning. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Two colleagues are in dispute. Tom says Lena sends her reports late. Lena says the data she needs arrives late. As a mediator, propose a solution with an owner and a deadline for each action, and summarise the agreement in two sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki hamkasb bahslashmoqda. Tom Lena hisobotlarni kech yuboradi, deydi. Lena esa kerakli ma’lumot kech keladi, deydi. Mediator sifatida mas’ul va muddatli yechim taklif qiling va kelishuvni ikki gapda xulosa qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kelishuv
board: Tom sends the data by Tuesday noon.
Lena sends the report by Thursday.
To summarise, we have agreed two actions.

examples.t: Tom will send the data by Tuesday noon, and Lena will send the report by Thursday.
examples.uz: Tom ma’lumotni seshanba tushgacha, Lena esa hisobotni payshanbagacha yuboradi.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin yechim: „Tom will send the data to Lena by Tuesday noon, and Lena will send the finished report by Thursday. To summarise, we have agreed two actions with clear owners and deadlines, and we will review progress next Monday. Are we all on the same page?“ Yechim ikkala e’tirozni hal qiladi, har bir harakatning mas’uli va sanasi bor. Oxirida keyingi tekshiruv ham belgilandi: „review progress next Monday“. Muhim: yechim hech kimni ayblamaydi, jarayonni tuzatadi. Shunday kelishuvdan keyin ikki tomon ham o‘zini yutgan his qiladi.
scenes.say: A possible solution. Tom will send the data to Lena by Tuesday noon, and Lena will send the finished report by Thursday. To summarise, we have agreed two actions with clear owners and deadlines, and we will review progress next Monday. Are we all on the same page? The solution addresses both complaints, and each action has an owner and a date.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin yechim. Tom ma’lumotni Lenaga seshanba tushgacha, Lena esa tayyor hisobotni payshanbagacha yuboradi. Xulosa qilib, mas’ul va muddatli ikki harakatga kelishdik, keyingi dushanba natijani ko‘rib chiqamiz. Hammamiz bir fikrdamizmi? Yechim ikkala e’tirozni ham hal qiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: fikr-mulohaza suhbati
board: Manager: Can I give you some feedback on the client meeting?
Manager: You interrupted the client twice, and she seemed frustrated.
Employee: I did not realise. I was trying to help.
Manager: I know. Next time, let her finish first.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbat — rahbar fikr-mulohaza beradi. Rahbar: mijoz bilan uchrashuv haqida fikr-mulohaza bersam bo‘ladimi? Xodim: albatta. Rahbar: uchrashuvda siz mijozning gapini ikki marta bo‘ldingiz va u biroz norozi ko‘rindi. Xodim: buni anglamabman, yordam bermoqchi edim. Rahbar: bilaman, tayyorgarligingiz a’lo edi. Keyingi safar javob berishdan oldin uning gapini tugatishiga imkon bera olasizmi? Eshiting: ruxsat so‘rash, SBI, xodimning niyatini tan olish va „feedforward“.
scenes.say: Can I give you some feedback on the client meeting? Of course. In the meeting, you interrupted the client twice, and she seemed a little frustrated. I did not realise that, I was trying to help. I know that, and your preparation was excellent. Next time, could you let her finish before you answer?
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz bilan uchrashuv haqida fikr-mulohaza bersam bo‘ladimi? Albatta. Uchrashuvda siz mijozning gapini ikki marta bo‘ldingiz va u biroz norozi ko‘rindi. Buni anglamabman, yordam bermoqchi edim. Bilaman, tayyorgarligingiz a’lo edi. Keyingi safar javob berishdan oldin uning gapini tugatishiga imkon bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) How does the manager begin?
2) What behaviour and impact are described?
3) What does the manager request?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Rahbar suhbatni qanday boshlaydi? Qaysi xatti-harakat va qanday ta’sir tasvirlanadi? Rahbar kelajak uchun nimani iltimos qiladi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Three questions. How does the manager begin the conversation? What behaviour and what impact are described? And what does the manager request for the future?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Rahbar suhbatni qanday boshlaydi? Qaysi xatti-harakat va qanday ta’sir tasvirlanadi? Rahbar kelajak uchun nimani iltimos qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: asks permission first
interrupted twice; client frustrated
let her finish next time
scenes.say_native: Rahbar ruxsat so‘rashdan boshlaydi: „Can I give you some feedback?“ Xatti-harakat — xodim mijozning gapini ikki marta bo‘lgan, ta’sir — mijoz norozi ko‘ringan. Rahbar kelajak uchun javob berishdan oldin uning gapini tugatishiga imkon berishni iltimos qiladi. Shuningdek, xodimning yaxshi tayyorgarligini ham tan oladi. Ko‘ryapsizmi, ruxsat so‘rash suhbatni hujumdan hamkorlikka aylantiradi, SBI esa uni aniq qiladi.
scenes.say: The manager begins by asking permission: can I give you some feedback. The behaviour is that the employee interrupted the client twice, and the impact is that she seemed frustrated. The manager requests that next time the employee lets her finish before answering. The manager also recognises the employee's good preparation.
scenes.say_uz: Rahbar ruxsat so‘rashdan boshlaydi. Xatti-harakat — xodim mijozning gapini ikki marta bo‘lgan, ta’sir — mijoz norozi ko‘ringan. Rahbar keyingi safar javob berishdan oldin mijoz gapini tugatishiga imkon berishni iltimos qiladi. Xodimning tayyorgarligini ham tan oladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: jamoa mojarosi
board: A: I feel my work is not being recognised.
B: So you feel your contribution is overlooked?
A: Yes, especially in the meetings.
B: Let us agree that you present the results next week.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — jamoa ichidagi norozilik. Birinchi hamkasb: sizga bir narsa haqida gapirsam bo‘ladimi? Ishim yig‘ilishlarda e’tirof etilmayotganini his qilyapman. Ikkinchisi: demak, hissangizcha, hissangiz e’tibordan chetda qolmoqdami? Ha, ayniqsa natijalar taqdim etilganda. Ikkinchisi: bu nega xafa qiluvchi ekanini tushunyapman. Sizga nima mos? Ehtimol, kelasi hafta natijalarni men taqdim etarman, keyin qanday ketganini ko‘rib chiqamiz. Diqqat: qayta aytish, hissiyotni tan olish, „what would work for you“ va aniq kelishuv.
scenes.say: Can I talk to you about something? I feel my work is not being recognised in the meetings. So you feel your contribution is being overlooked? Yes, especially when the results are presented. I can see why that would be frustrating. What would work for you? Perhaps I could present the results next week, and we review how it goes.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga bir narsa haqida gapirsam bo‘ladimi? Ishim yig‘ilishlarda e’tirof etilmayotganini his qilyapman. Demak, hissangiz e’tibordan chetda qolayotganmi? Ha, ayniqsa natijalar taqdim etilganda. Bu nega xafa qilishini tushunyapman. Sizga nima mos? Kelasi hafta natijalarni siz taqdim etsangiz, keyin qanday ketganini ko‘rib chiqsak.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is A’s concern?
2) How does B check understanding?
3) What do they agree?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi so‘zlovchi nimadan xavotirda? Ikkinchisi tushunganini qanday tekshiradi? Ular nimaga kelishadi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Questions on the second conversation. What is the first speaker's concern? How does the second speaker check that they have understood? And what do they agree to do?
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi so‘zlovchi nimadan xavotirda? Ikkinchisi tushunganini qanday tekshiradi? Ular nimaga kelishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: work not recognised in meetings
paraphrases: So you feel…?
A presents the results next week; review
scenes.say_native: Birinchi so‘zlovchi ishi yig‘ilishlarda e’tirof etilmayotganidan xavotirda. Ikkinchisi tushunganini qayta aytish bilan tekshiradi: „So you feel your contribution is being overlooked?“ Ular birinchi so‘zlovchi kelasi hafta natijalarni taqdim etishiga va keyin qanday ketganini ko‘rib chiqishga kelishadi. Shunday qilib, suhbat hissiyotdan aniq yechimga o‘tdi. Mana, endi hamma ko‘nikmani yakuniy topshiriqda birlashtiramiz.
scenes.say: The first speaker is worried that their work is not recognised in meetings. The second speaker checks understanding by paraphrasing: so you feel your contribution is being overlooked. They agree that the first speaker will present the results next week, and they will review how it goes.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi so‘zlovchi ishi yig‘ilishlarda e’tirof etilmayotganidan xavotirda. Ikkinchisi qayta aytish bilan tushunganini tekshiradi. Ular birinchi so‘zlovchi kelasi hafta natijalarni taqdim etishiga va keyin qanday ketganini ko‘rib chiqishga kelishadi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: rolli suhbat
board: Role: manager. Situation: an employee keeps missing small deadlines and is now upset.
Use: SBI · listening · de-escalation · agreement
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq, rolli suhbat. Siz rahbarsiz. Xodim bir nechta kichik muddatni o‘tkazib yubordi va siz buni aytganingizda u xafa bo‘ldi. Taxminan oltita gapda SBI bilan fikr-mulohaza bering, faol tinglash iborasini ishlating, keskinlikni pasaytiring va muddatli bitta harakatga kelishing. Baland ovozda ayting, keyin namunani eshiting.
scenes.say: Final task, a role-play. You are a manager. An employee has missed several small deadlines, and now they are upset when you raise it. In about six sentences, give SBI feedback, use an active-listening phrase, de-escalate, and agree one action with a deadline.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq, rolli suhbat. Siz rahbarsiz. Xodim bir nechta kichik muddatni o‘tkazib yubordi va siz buni aytganingizda xafa bo‘ldi. Taxminan oltita gapda fikr-mulohaza bering, tinglang, tinchlantiring va muddatli harakatga kelishing.

scenes.title: Namuna rolli suhbat
board: SBI · listen · de-escalate · agree
scenes.say_native: Namuna: „Over the past two weeks, three reports reached me after the deadline, and that delayed the client update.“ — SBI. „I can see this is difficult to hear. So you feel the workload has become unmanageable?“ — hissiyotni tan olish va qayta aytish. „Let us look at it together. What would work for you?“ — keskinlikni pasaytirish. „Shall we agree that you send a short progress note every Wednesday, and we review it next Friday?“ — kim, nima, qachon. Sizning variantingiz boshqa so‘zlardan iborat bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin to‘rt qism bo‘lishi kerak: fakt va ta’sir, tinglash, tinchlantirish, aniq kelishuv.
scenes.say: Over the past two weeks, three reports reached me after the deadline, and that delayed the client update. I can see this is difficult to hear. So you feel the workload has become unmanageable? Let us look at it together. What would work for you? Shall we agree that you send a short progress note every Wednesday, and we review it next Friday?
scenes.say_uz: Namuna. Oxirgi ikki haftada uchta hisobot muddatdan keyin keldi va mijozga yangilik kechikdi. Buni eshitish qiyin ekanini ko‘ryapman. Demak, ish yuklamasi chidab bo‘lmas darajaga yetganmi? Birga ko‘rib chiqamiz. Sizga nima mos? Har chorshanba qisqa yo‘nalish xati yuborishingizga va keyingi juma ko‘rib chiqishimizga kelishamizmi?

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: SBI · start-stop-continue · feedforward
paraphrase · empathise · ask for detail
acknowledge · lower voice · focus on the fix
who · what · by when
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: fikr-mulohazani xatti-harakat va ta’sir bo‘yicha bering, xarakter bo‘yicha emas. Ikkinchi: faol tinglang va qayta ayting. Uchinchi: tushuntirishdan oldin tan oling, ovozni pasaytiring va „calm down“ demang. To‘rtinchi: aniq kelishuv bilan yakunlang: kim, nima, qachongacha. Bu to‘rt qadam qiyin suhbatlarni samarali suhbatga aylantiradi.
scenes.say: To recap. Give feedback on behaviour and impact, not on character. Listen actively and paraphrase. De-escalate by acknowledging before explaining, and never say calm down. And finish with a clear agreement: who does what by when.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Fikr-mulohazani xatti-harakat va ta’sir bo‘yicha bering. Faol tinglang va qayta ayting. Tushuntirishdan oldin tan oling va calm down demang. Aniq kelishuv bilan yakunlang: kim, nima, qachongacha.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Role-play a feedback conversation
Record 2-3 minutes with a partner or alone (both roles)
Success: SBI + listening + agreement with owner and deadline
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: fikr-mulohaza suhbatini rolli o‘yin sifatida mashq qiling. Sherik bilan yoki ikkala rolni o‘zingiz o‘ynab, ikki-uch daqiqalik yozuv qiling. Suhbatda SBI bilan fikr-mulohaza, faol tinglash va aniq kelishuv bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kelishuvda mas’ul va muddat aniq bo‘lsa va birorta ham yorliq yoki „calm down“ ishlatilmasa. Keyingi darsda liderlik va jamoani boshqarish tilini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to role-play a feedback conversation. Record two or three minutes, with a partner or by playing both roles. Include SBI feedback, active listening and a clear agreement. Next lesson: leadership and team management. Excellent work today.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: fikr-mulohaza suhbatini rolli o‘yin sifatida ikki-uch daqiqalik yozib oling. SBI fikr-mulohaza, faol tinglash va aniq kelishuv bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: liderlik va jamoani boshqarish. Bugun a’lo ishladingiz.

homework_uz: Fikr-mulohaza suhbatini rolli o‘yin sifatida ikki-uch daqiqalik yozib oling: SBI bilan fikr-mulohaza, faol tinglash va mas’ul hamda muddatli aniq kelishuv bo‘lsin. Yorliq va calm down ishlatmang. Keyingi dars: liderlik va jamoani boshqarish.

quiz.q: Which is an observation, not a label?
"So what you are saying is…" is used to ___.
Which phrase should you avoid when de-escalating?
options: I can see why you are upset.
What matters now is a solution.
quiz.why_uz: Calm down odamni battar jahlini chiqaradi.

options: Sara will send the draft by Wednesday noon.
We will sort it out soon.

quiz.why_uz: Odam bilan rozi bo‘lish: agree with.

quiz.q: Which is the best response to an angry customer?
options: I can see why you are upset, and I am sorry.

quiz.q: Where should criticism ideally be given?
"Are we on the same page?" means ___.
options: Are we reading the same book?
